title: The loop closes exited Mainworks panes left in removed worktrees
description: Run a loop cycle over a Herdr inventory holding an exited Mainworks pane in a removed worktree, the master pane, a pane Mainworks did not launch and a pane whose agent still runs. Only the dead Mainworks pane closes, and the cycle records the orphaned processes it stopped behind removed worktrees; an idle pane of a live session in an existing worktree stays open (GY-3188).

steps.name: Close dead worktree panes and keep the rest
